segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Hi Dan,

Attached is the quote for 28 seats of the analytics workspace, annual term starting July 1. Software is $27,216 for the year, onboarding is $2,400 one-time, and support is included.

If you want the June 17 kickoff, I’d need signature by June 7 so services can hold the slot.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, Customer
segments.text:
Thanks Maya.

A few items:
- We may only need 26 seats at go-live, with 2 more in September.
- Finance wants invoices net 45 if possible.
- Can onboarding be split across the first two invoices?

The July 1 start date is still fine.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Dan,

26 seats now and 2 later is fine. The contract can show 28 total with 26 active on day one, or we can start with 26 and add the rest by order form in September.

Net 45 is okay. For onboarding, billing tool can split it 50/50 across the July and August invoices.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, Customer
segments.text:
Let’s keep 28 in the contract so procurement doesn’t have to reopen it.

Budget is the sticking point. I have $25k all-in approved for year one, including onboarding. If we’re above that, I need to take it back to the VP and that pushes us past the kickoff date.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Yep, understood. Use the $24,480 figure from my text for the PO and I’ll get the quote packet cleaned up when the pricing sheet is updated.

Everything else stays the same: 28 seats, July 1 start, net 45, onboarding split across July/August.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, Customer
segments.text:
That works.

Please send the order form with:
- 28 seats
- July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027
- $24,480 year-one total
- Net 45
- Onboarding split evenly over first two invoices

I’ll route it today.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Attached.

I also included the security addendum and the support terms procurement asked for last week. No changes to the data processing language from the last draft.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, Customer
segments.text:
Received. Procurement asked one question: can the renewal cap be 5% instead of 7%?

If yes, I think we can get signatures by Friday.

Dan

segments.speaker: Maya Chen, Rep
segments.text:
Yes, 5% renewal cap is fine. I updated section 4.2 and reattached the order form.

Maya

segments.speaker: Dan Miller, Customer
segments.text:
Signed copy attached.

Please have billing send the first invoice to ap@northlakeexample.com and copy me. We’ll send user names for the first 26 seats by June 12.

Dan
